data.name: AgingAdvancesToSuppliers
data.value:
--Declare @PeriodID int = 1 --Declare @FromDate datetime = '2019-10-01 00:00:00:000' --Declare @ToDate datetime = '2021-09-30 00:00:00:000'
select [Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax].CustomerCategory,tab.Supplier,tab.NoOfDays,(AdvanceAmount - InvoiceAmount) as Balance
,isnull( (select SUM(t.Amount) as Amount from ( select distinct sum(AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount) as Amount from AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail inner join GL_CodecombinationDetail on GL_CodecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode and GL_CodecombinationDetail.Status = 1
inner join AR_InvoiceHeader on AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID and AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 and AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1
inner join AR_Set_Businesspartner on AR_Set_Businesspartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID
inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 inner JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID
where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = tab.CustomerID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = tab.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = tab.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status = 1 and GL_CodecombinationDetail.Description like '%doubt%' and AR_Set_Businesspartner.BusinessPartnerName like '%Provision of Doubtful Debt%' and AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID
UNION ALL
select distinct sum(AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount) as Amount from AP_PaymentSupplierDetail inner join GL_CodecombinationDetail on GL_CodecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode and GL_CodecombinationDetail.Status = 1
inner join AP_PaymentHeader on AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1
inner join AR_Set_Businesspartner on AR_Set_Businesspartner.BusinessPartnerID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID
inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 inner JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID
where AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID = tab.CustomerID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = tab.CompanyID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = tab.PeriodID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Status = 1 and GL_CodecombinationDetail.Description like '%doubt%' and AR_Set_Businesspartner.BusinessPartnerName like '%Provision of Doubtful Debt%' and AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID )t) ,0) as DoubtfulAmount
from ( select AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID,AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as Supplier,AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo as AdvancePoNumber ,AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate,AP_PaymentHeader.Amount as AdvanceAmount,AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber as PONumber,AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.AdvanceAmountPercentage
,isnull(( select sum(GrossAmount) from Ar_invoiceDetail where Ar_invoiceDetail.PurchaseOrderHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID and Ar_invoiceDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and Ar_invoiceDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID and Ar_invoiceDetail.Status = 1 ),0) + isnull((
select sum(Amount) from (
select distinct AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceSupplierID, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount from Ar_invoiceDetail inner join AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = Ar_invoiceDetail .InvoiceHeaderID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = Ar_invoiceDetail .CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = Ar_invoiceDetail .PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status = 1 where Ar_invoiceDetail.PurchaseOrderHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID and Ar_invoiceDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and Ar_invoiceDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID and Ar_invoiceDetail.Status = 1 and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Narration = 'GST' )as tab ),0) as InvoiceAmount ,DATEDIFF(DAY, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate , GETDATE()) AS NoOfDays ,AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CreatedByValue ,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader inner join Set_DocumentType on Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode and Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID
inner join AP_PaymentHeader on AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID and AP_PaymentHeader.status = 1
inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 inner JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID
where AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.status = 1 and isnull(AdvanceAmountPercentage,0) > 0 and convert(date,AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate) between @FromDate and @ToDate )as tab
inner join [Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax] on [Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax].CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = tab.CustomerCategoryID and [Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax].Status = 1
where (AdvanceAmount - InvoiceAmount) > 0

data.name: AgingPayableToSuppliers
data.value:
select CustomerCategory,Supplier,sum(NoOfDays) as NoOfDays,abs(sum(Balance)) as Balance,RetentionMoney from ( select [Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax].CustomerCategory,tab.Supplier,tab.NoOfDays,(InvoiceAmount - PaymentAmount) as Balance
,isnull( (select SUM(t.Amount) as Amount from ( select distinct sum(AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount) as Amount from AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail inner join GL_CodecombinationDetail on GL_CodecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode and GL_CodecombinationDetail.Status = 1
inner join AR_InvoiceHeader on AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID and AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 and AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1
inner join AR_Set_Businesspartner on AR_Set_Businesspartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID
inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 inner JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID
where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = tab.CustomerID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = tab.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = tab.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status = 1 and GL_CodecombinationDetail.Description like '%retention%' and AR_Set_Businesspartner.BusinessPartnerName like '%Retention money%' and AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate <= @AsOnDate and AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID
UNION ALL
select distinct sum(AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount) as Amount from AP_PaymentSupplierDetail inner join GL_CodecombinationDetail on GL_CodecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode and GL_CodecombinationDetail.Status = 1
inner join AP_PaymentHeader on AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1
inner join AR_Set_Businesspartner on AR_Set_Businesspartner.BusinessPartnerID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID
inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 inner JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID
where AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID = tab.CustomerID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = tab.CompanyID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = tab.PeriodID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Status = 1 and GL_CodecombinationDetail.Description like '%retention%' and AR_Set_Businesspartner.BusinessPartnerName like '%Retention money%' and AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate <= @AsOnDate and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID )t) ,0) as RetentionMoney
from (
select AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID,AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as Supplier, AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid as InvoiceAmount ,DATEDIFF(DAY, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate , GETDATE()) AS NoOfDays,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID
, isnull((
select sum(Amount) from (
select distinct AP_PaymentHeader.Amount from AP_PaymentHeader inner join Set_DocumentType on Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and AP_PaymentHeader.status = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1
inner join AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail on AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.status = 1
where AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
)as tab
),0) as PaymentAmount
from AR_InvoiceHeader inner join Set_DocumentType on Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType and Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceHeader.status = 1 and AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID
inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 inner JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID
where AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AR_InvoiceHeader.status = 1 and AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate <= @AsOnDate and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType not like '%DI-Invoice (HR)%' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Vendor Invoice%' {0}
)as tab
inner join [Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax] on [Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax].CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = tab.CustomerCategoryID and [Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax].Status = 1
where (InvoiceAmount - PaymentAmount) > 0
UNION ALL
select [Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax].CustomerCategory,tab.Supplier,tab.NoOfDays,(InvoiceAmount - PaymentAmount) as Balance
,isnull( (select SUM(t.Amount) as Amount from ( select distinct sum(AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount) as Amount from AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail inner join GL_CodecombinationDetail on GL_CodecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode and GL_CodecombinationDetail.Status = 1
inner join AR_InvoiceHeader on AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID and AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 and AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1
inner join AR_Set_Businesspartner on AR_Set_Businesspartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID
inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 inner JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID
where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = tab.CustomerID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = tab.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = tab.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status = 1 and GL_CodecombinationDetail.Description like '%retention%' and AR_Set_Businesspartner.BusinessPartnerName like '%Retention money%' and AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate <= @AsOnDate and AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID
UNION ALL
select distinct sum(AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount) as Amount from AP_PaymentSupplierDetail inner join GL_CodecombinationDetail on GL_CodecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode and GL_CodecombinationDetail.Status = 1
inner join AP_PaymentHeader on AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1
inner join AR_Set_Businesspartner on AR_Set_Businesspartner.BusinessPartnerID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID
inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 inner JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID
where AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID = tab.CustomerID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = tab.CompanyID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = tab.PeriodID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Status = 1 and GL_CodecombinationDetail.Description like '%retention%' and AR_Set_Businesspartner.BusinessPartnerName like '%Retention money%' and AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate <= @AsOnDate and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID )t) ,0) as RetentionMoney
from (
select distinct AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID,AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as Supplier, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount as InvoiceAmount ,DATEDIFF(DAY, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate , GETDATE()) AS NoOfDays,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID
, isnull((
select sum(Amount) from (
select AP_PaymentHeader.Amount from AP_PaymentHeader inner join Set_DocumentType on Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and AP_PaymentHeader.status = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1
inner join AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail on AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.status = 1
where AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
)as tab
),0) as PaymentAmount
from AR_InvoiceHeader inner join Set_DocumentType on Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType and Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceHeader.status = 1 and AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1
left join AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.status = 1
left join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID
inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 inner JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID
where AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AR_InvoiceHeader.status = 1 and AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate <= @AsOnDate and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType not like '%DI-Invoice (HR)%' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType not like '%Vendor Invoice%' {0}
)as tab
inner join [Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax] on [Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax].CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = tab.CustomerCategoryID and [Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax].Status = 1
where (InvoiceAmount - PaymentAmount) > 0
union all
--Advance PO select [Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax].CustomerCategory,tab.Supplier,tab.NoOfDays,(InvoiceAmount - PaymentAmount) as Balance
,0 as RetentionMoney
from (
select distinct AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID,AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as Supplier, 0 as InvoiceAmount ,0 AS NoOfDays,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID
, AP_PaymentHeader.Amount as PaymentAmount
from AP_PaymentHeader inner join Set_DocumentType on Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and AP_PaymentHeader.status = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID
inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 inner JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID
where AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AP_PaymentHeader.status = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate <= @AsOnDate and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%advance%'
{0}
)as tab
inner join [Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax] on [Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax].CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = tab.CustomerCategoryID and [Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax].Status = 1
union all
--Direct Payment select [Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax].CustomerCategory,tab.Supplier,tab.NoOfDays,(InvoiceAmount - PaymentAmount) as Balance
,0 as RetentionMoney
from (
select distinct AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID,AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as Supplier, 0 as InvoiceAmount ,0 AS NoOfDays,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID ,AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount as PaymentAmount from AP_PaymentHeader inner join Set_DocumentType on Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and AP_PaymentHeader.status = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1
inner join AP_PaymentSupplierDetail on AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.status = 1
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID
inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 inner JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID
where AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AP_PaymentHeader.status = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate <= @AsOnDate and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%direct%'
{0}
)as tab
inner join [Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax] on [Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax].CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = tab.CustomerCategoryID and [Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax].Status = 1
)as tab group by CustomerCategory,Supplier,RetentionMoney

data.name: LeaseFinanceYearlyPositionCrossReport
data.value: select LeaseType ,BankName,Year,sum(Rate) as Amount from ( select case LeaseType when 1 then 'Ijarah' when 2 then 'Musharka' when 3 then 'LeaseFinancing' else '' end as LeaseType ,AR_SET_Bank .BankName ,year(PurchaseDate) as Year ,FA_LeaseHeader.Rate from FA_LeaseHeader inner join AR_SET_BankBranch on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = FA_LeaseHeader.BankBranchID inner join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID where FA_LeaseHeader.status = 1 and FA_LeaseHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and FA_LeaseHeader.CreateDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate )as tab group by LeaseType ,BankName,Year order by LeaseType ,BankName

data.name: QueryFor_NewStafffacilitiesReport
data.value: select distinct AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,(AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName + ' - ' + SET_JobDesignation .JobDesignationName) as CustomerName,SET_JobDesignation .JobDesignationName, Set_StaffFacilitesDetail.FacilityName as BusinessPartnerName ,Set_StaffFacilitesDetail.Limit ,(AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount) as Amount ,DATENAME(month,AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate) as MonthDate , Set_StaffFacilites.VehicleNo from Set_StaffFacilites inner join Set_StaffFacilitesDetail on Set_StaffFacilitesDetail.StaffFacilitesHeaderID = Set_StaffFacilites.StaffFacilityID and Set_StaffFacilitesDetail.CompanyID = Set_StaffFacilites.CompanyID and Set_StaffFacilitesDetail.PeriodID = Set_StaffFacilites.PeriodID and Set_StaffFacilitesDetail.Status = 1 left join AP_PaymentSupplierDetail on Set_StaffFacilites.StaffID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode = Set_StaffFacilitesDetail.AccountCode and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = Set_StaffFacilitesDetail.CompanyID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = Set_StaffFacilitesDetail.PeriodID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Status = 1 left join AP_PaymentHeader on AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentSupplierID and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID and AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.statuscode = 1 inner join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_CustomerID = Set_StaffFacilites.StaffID and HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID = Set_StaffFacilites.CompanyID and HRMS_Set_Employee.Status = 1 left join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID --left join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_CustomerID inner join SET_JobDesignation on SET_JobDesignation.JobDesignationID = HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_JobDesignationID where --AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName like '%'+Set_StaffFacilitesDetail.FacilityName +'%' and Set_StaffFacilites.CompanyID = @CompanyID and Set_StaffFacilites.PeriodID = @PeriodID and Set_StaffFacilites.status = 1 --and AP_PaymentHeader.FiscalID = @FiscalID and convert(date,Set_StaffFacilites.EffectedFrom) between @FromDate and @ToDate -- group by AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,SET_JobDesignation .JobDesignationName, Set_StaffFacilitesDetail.FacilityName --,Set_StaffFacilitesDetail.Limit --,DATENAME(month,AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate),AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, Set_StaffFacilites.VehicleNo

data.name: Query_CheckAmount_AdvanceAgainstPurchasecontract

,AP_PaidUnPaidWHTDetail.ClaimHeaderID, AP_PaidUnPaidWHTDetail.ClaimDate as ClaimDates --, AP_PaidUnPaidWHTDetail.ClaimDetailID ,AR_Set_Businesspartner.BusinessPartnerID, = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Status = 1 left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode Left join AP_PaidUnPaidWHTDetail on AP_PaidUnPaidWHTDetail.PaymentID = data.name: Query_GetPaymentExchangeRate
data.value: SELECT ISNULL(SUM(AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount), 0)/SUM(AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.AmountDollar) AS Amount FROM AP_PaymentHeader INNER JOIN AP_PaymentSupplierDetail ON AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID=AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID=AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID=AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Status=1 LEFT JOIN AP_SaleContractHeader ON AP_SaleContractHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND AP_SaleContractHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND AP_SaleContractHeader.SaleContractID = AP_PaymentHeader.SourceHeaderID AND AP_SaleContractHeader.Status = 1 WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.SourceHeaderID = @ContractHeaderID And AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID In (select documenttypeid from set_documenttype where documenttype like '%purchase contract%' AND isActive=1) -- And AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1

Query_GetPaymentForPaymentTaxLookup
data.value: SELECT AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID, AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate, AP_PaymentHeader.ReceiptDate as PaymentDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description, AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PaymentDetailAccountID, AP_PaymentHeader.CurrencyID, AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode, AP_PaymentHeader.Status, '' as BankCodeCombinationID, '' as BranchID, '' as BankAccountID, '' as Narration, '' as Marked, ROW_NUMBER() Over (Order by AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID, AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID, AP_PaymentHeader.paymentid) as 'Row' FROM AP_PaymentHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID left outer JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID --AND AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND dbo.AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.ChartOfAccountID = @ChartOfAccountID --AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.IsTaxAccount = 1 and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1 inner join AP_Payment_AccountsDetail on AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Status = 1 and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.IsMarked is null WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID in ( SELECT distinct PaymentHeaderID FROM AP_Payment_AccountsDetail inner join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.ChartOfAccountID = @ChartOfAccountID --AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.IsTaxAccount = 1 and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1 where AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Status = 1 and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.IsMarked is null )

data.name: Query_GetPaymentReceiptReortData
data.value:
select AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate as PostingDate, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, CASE AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode When 1 then 'Approved' When 2 then 'Cancelled' When 3 then 'Effective' When 4 then 'Expired' When 5 then 'In Process' When 6 then 'Incomplete' When 7 then 'Pre Approved' When 8 then 'Rejected' When 9 then 'Requires Reapproval' When 10 then 'Returned' when 11 then 'Open' When 12 then 'Release For Approve' When 13 then 'Partially Approved' End AS CurrentStatus, AP_PaymentHeader.Reference as DocumentReference, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo as ChequeNo, AP_PaymentHeader.ReceiptDate as ChequeDate, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode, CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as SupplierName, AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 as SupplierAddress, AR_SET_Customer.ZipCode as SupplierZipCode, AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber as SupplierPhone, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber, AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber, CitySupp.CityName as SupplierCity, AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchName, IsNull(AP_PaymentHeader.Comments, '') + IsNull(AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments, '') As Comments, ISNULL(AP_PaymentHeader.WithHoldingTax, 0) as WithHoldingTax, isnull(AP_PaymentHeader.Amount, 0) as Amount, isnull(BankTD.Amount, 0) BankAmount, --isnull(GL_TransactionHeader.ControlCredit, AP_PaymentHeader.Amount) VenderAmount, (AP_PaymentHeader.Amount) VenderAmount, CASE (ISNULL((Select SUM(AP_PaymentTaxes.TaxAmount) FROM AP_PaymentTaxes WHERE AP_PaymentTaxes.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID), 0)) when 0 then Isnull(TaxTD.Amount, 0) else (ISNULL((Select SUM(AP_PaymentTaxes.TaxAmount) FROM AP_PaymentTaxes WHERE AP_PaymentTaxes.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID), 0)) END AS TaxAmount, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, CASE AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName when null then AR_SET_Bank.BankName end as BankName, CASE WHEN DocumentType like '%Cash Withdrawal%' THEN 'Cash' when DocumentType like '%Bank Charges%' then AR_SET_Bank.BankName when DocumentType like '%Payment Transfer%' then 'Bank Transfer' else '' end as Reciever, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber as PODocNo, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate as PODate, BA.BankAccountName as DetailBankAccountName, BB.BankBranchName as DetailBankBranchName, SET_ReceiptMethod.ReceiptMethodName, AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount as DetailAmount, AP_PaymentBanksDetail.TransactionType, AP_PaymentBanksDetail.InstrumentNo --,isnull((AP_PaymentHeader.UpdatedByValue),AP_PaymentHeader.CreatedByValue) as PreparedBy ,AP_PaymentHeader.CreatedByValue as PreparedBy , Case when AP_PaymentHeader.statuscode=1 then isnull(( select top 1 CreatedByValue from SET_DocumentApprove where Set_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and Set_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNO and Set_DocumentApprove.FiscalID = AP_PaymentHeader.FiscalID order by DocumentApproveID desc ),AP_PaymentHeader.CreatedByValue) else '' end as ApprovedBy, SET_OperatingUnit.LogoImage, AP_PaymentHeader.PayeeName, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AP_PaymentHeader.Reference
from AP_PaymentHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID
left JOIN GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo and AP_PaymentHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID
left join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID --and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID left join AR_SET_BankAccount on AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID = AP_PaymentHeader.BankAccountID --and AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID
left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail as BankCC on BankCC.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PaymentCCID and BankCC.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID
left join GL_TransactionDetail as BankTD on BankTD.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PaymentCCID and BankTD.SourceHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and BankTD.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and BankTD.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = BankTD.TransactionID

SELECT AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate as PostingDate, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, CASE AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode When 1 then 'Approved' When 2 then 'Cancelled' When 3 then 'Effective' When 4 then 'Expired' When 5 then 'In Process' When 6 then 'Incomplete' When 7 then 'Pre Approved' When 8 then 'Rejected' When 9 then 'Requires Reapproval' When 10 then 'Returned' when 11 then 'Open' When 12 then 'Release For Approve' When 13 then 'Partially Approved' End AS CurrentStatus, AP_PaymentHeader.Reference as DocumentReference, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo as ChequeNo, AP_PaymentHeader.ReceiptDate as ChequeDate, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode, CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as SupplierName, AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 as SupplierAddress, AR_SET_Customer.ZipCode as SupplierZipCode, AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber as SupplierPhone, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber, AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber, CitySupp.CityName as SupplierCity, AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchName, AP_PaymentHeader.Comments, AP_PaymentHeader.Amount, isnull(BankTD.Amount, 0) BankAmount, isnull(GL_TransactionHeader.ControlCredit, 0) VenderAmount, CASE (ISNULL((Select SUM(AP_PaymentTaxes.TaxAmount) FROM AP_PaymentTaxes WHERE AP_PaymentTaxes.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID), 0)) when 0 then (Isnull(TaxTD.Amount, 0) + ISNULL(TaxService.Amount, 0) + ISNULL(TaxSuplies.Amount, 0) + ISNULL(TaxTransport.Amount, 0)) else (ISNULL((Select SUM(AP_PaymentTaxes.TaxAmount) FROM AP_PaymentTaxes WHERE AP_PaymentTaxes.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID), 0)) END AS TaxAmount, (ISNULL(TaxService.Amount, 0) + ISNULL(TaxTransport.Amount, 0) + ISNULL(TaxSuplies.Amount, 0)) WHT, Isnull(AR_Set_Customer.AdditionalDeductionTaxRate, 0) AdditionalTax, ISNULL(AR_SET_Customer.ServiceItemTaxRate, 0) as ServiceTax, ISNULL(AR_SET_Customer.TransporterTaxRate, 0) as TranspotarTax, ISNULL(AR_Set_Customer.SuppliesTaxRate, 0) as SupliesTax, ISNULL(TaxTD.Amount, 0) as AddtionalAmount, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, CASE AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName when null then AR_SET_Bank.BankName end as BankName, CASE WHEN DocumentType like '%Cash Withdrawal%' THEN 'Cash' when DocumentType like '%Bank Charges%' then AR_SET_Bank.BankName when DocumentType like '%Payment Transfer%' then 'Bank Transfer' else '' end as Reciever, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.Amount As InvoiceAmount, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, AR_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount as InvoiceTax, SET_OperatingUnit.Logoimage as LogoImage from AP_PaymentHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID left JOIN GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo left join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID --and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID left join AR_SET_BankAccount on AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID = AP_PaymentHeader.BankAccountID --and AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail as BankCC on BankCC.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PaymentCCID and BankCC.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID left join GL_TransactionDetail as BankTD on BankTD.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PaymentCCID and BankTD.SourceHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and BankTD.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and BankTD.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = BankTD.TransactionID left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail as VenderCC on VenderCC.CodeCombinationID = [AR_SET_Customer].CustomerAccountCCID and VenderCC.CompanyID = [AP_PaymentHeader].CompanyID left join GL_TransactionDetail as VenderTD on VenderTD.CodeCombinationID = [AR_SET_Customer].CustomerAccountCCID and VenderTD.SourceHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and VenderTD.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and VenderTD.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and [GL_TransactionHeader].[TransactionID] = VenderTD.[TransactionID]
left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail as TaxCC on TaxCC.CodeCombinationID = [AR_SET_Customer].SuppliesTaxCOA and TaxCC.CompanyID = [AP_PaymentHeader].CompanyID
left join GL_TransactionDetail as TaxSuplies on TaxSuplies.CodeCombinationID = [AR_SET_Customer].SuppliesTaxCOA and TaxSuplies.SourceHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and TaxSuplies.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and TaxSuplies.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and [GL_TransactionHeader].[TransactionID] = TaxSuplies.[TransactionID] left join GL_TransactionDetail as TaxTD on TaxTD.CodeCombinationID = [AR_SET_Customer].AdditionalDeductionCOA and TaxTD.SourceHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and TaxTD.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and TaxTD.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and [GL_TransactionHeader].[TransactionID] = TaxTD.[TransactionID] left join GL_TransactionDetail as TaxService on TaxService.CodeCombinationID = [AR_SET_Customer].ServiceItemTaxCOA and TaxService.SourceHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and TaxService.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and TaxService.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and [GL_TransactionHeader].[TransactionID] = TaxService.[TransactionID] left join GL_TransactionDetail as TaxTransport on TaxTransport.CodeCombinationID = [AR_SET_Customer].TransporterTaxCOA and TaxTransport.SourceHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and TaxTransport.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and TaxTransport.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and [GL_TransactionHeader].[TransactionID] = TaxTransport.[TransactionID]
left join [AR_SET_BankBranch] on [AR_SET_BankBranch].[BankBranchID] = [AP_PaymentHeader].[CustomerBankBranchID] inner join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID = [AR_SET_BankBranch].BankID left Join [SET_Company] ON [SET_Company].[CompanyId] = [AP_PaymentHeader].[CompanyID] left Join [SET_OperatingUnit] ON [SET_OperatingUnit].[OperatingUnitId] = [SET_Company].[OperatingUnitId] Inner Join [SET_Business] ON [SET_Business].[BusinessId] = [SET_Company].[BusinessId] Left Join [SET_City] AS [CitySupp] ON [CitySupp].[CityID] = [AR_SET_Customer].[CityID] Left Join [SET_City] AS [CityComp] ON [CityComp].[CityID] = [SET_OperatingUnit].[CityID]
LEFT JOIN AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail ON AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID
LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail ON AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
where [AP_PaymentHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID and [AP_PaymentHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID {0} AND [AP_PaymentHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = @DocumentTypeID order by [AP_PaymentHeader].[DocumentNo] ASC

(ISNULL((Select SUM(AP_PaymentTaxes.TaxAmount) FROM AP_PaymentTaxes WHERE AP_PaymentTaxes.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID), 0)) END AS TaxAmount, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, CASE AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName when null then AR_SET_Bank.BankName end as BankName, CASE WHEN DocumentType like '%Cash Withdrawal%' THEN 'Cash' when DocumentType like '%Bank Charges%' then AR_SET_Bank.BankName when DocumentType like '%Payment Transfer%' then 'Bank Transfer' else '' end as Reciever, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber as PODocNo, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate as PODate, BA.BankAccountName as DetailBankAccountName, BB.BankBranchName as DetailBankBranchName, SET_ReceiptMethod.ReceiptMethodName, AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount as DetailAmount, AP_PaymentBanksDetail.TransactionType, AP_PaymentBanksDetail.InstrumentNo --,isnull((AP_PaymentHeader.UpdatedByValue),AP_PaymentHeader.CreatedByValue) as PreparedBy ,AP_PaymentHeader.CreatedByValue as PreparedBy , Case when AP_PaymentHeader.statuscode=1 then isnull(( select top 1 CreatedByValue from SET_DocumentApprove where Set_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and as ApprovedBy, SET_OperatingUnit.LogoImage, AP_PaymentHeader.PayeeName, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AP_PaymentHeader.Reference

left join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID --and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID left join AR_SET_BankAccount on AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID = AP_PaymentHeader.BankAccountID --and AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID
left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail as BankCC on BankCC.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PaymentCCID and BankCC.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID

left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail as VenderCC on VenderCC.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerAccountCCID and VenderCC.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID
left join GL_TransactionDetail as VenderTD on VenderTD.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerAccountCCID and VenderTD.SourceHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and VenderTD.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and VenderTD.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = VenderTD.TransactionID
left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail as TaxCC on TaxCC.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_Customer.SuppliesTaxCOA and TaxCC.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID left join GL_TransactionDetail as TaxTD on TaxTD.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_Customer.SuppliesTaxCOA and TaxTD.SourceHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and TaxTD.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and TaxTD.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = TaxTD.TransactionID left join AR_SET_BankBranch on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AP_PaymentHeader.CustomerBankBranchID left join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID left Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID left Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId Left Join SET_City AS CitySupp ON CitySupp.CityID = AR_SET_Customer.CityID Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID LEFT JOIN AP_PurchaseOrderHeader ON AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.SourceHeaderID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.FiscalID = AP_PaymentHeader.FiscalID
left join AP_PaymentBanksDetail on AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Status=1
left join AR_SET_BankBranch BB on BB.BankBranchID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankBranchID left join AR_SET_BankAccount BA on BA.BankAccountID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID and BA.BankBranchID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankBranchID --and BA.CompanyID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID and BA.PeriodID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID
left join SET_ReceiptMethod on SET_ReceiptMethod.ReceiptMethodID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentMethodID left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail as SuppCC on SuppCC.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerAccountCCID left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail as BankDesc on BankDesc.CodeCombinationID = BA.PaymentCCID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID left join SET_CostCenter on SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = AP_PaymentHeader.CostCentreID and SET_CostCenter.Status = 1

select INV_Item.Description as IncurredOn, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType, ap_paymentHeader.PaymentID,[AP_PaymentHeader].[DocumentTypeID],[AP_PaymentHeader].[DocumentNo] , --AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID as AccountCodes , AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode as AccountCodes , ltrim(rtrim(SuppCC.Description)) as CodeDescription ,case AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType when 'Credit' then isnull(AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount, 0) *-1 when 'Debit' then isnull(AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount, 0) else 0 end as Amount ,AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Narration ,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.PayeeName, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AP_PaymentHeader.Reference from ap_paymentHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID inner join AP_PaymentSupplierDetail on AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Status = 1 and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID <> 46 -- Default Entry
left join AR_SET_Customer MultiCustomer on MultiCustomer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = MultiCustomer.CompanyID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = MultiCustomer.PeriodID -- left JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID=MultiCustomer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID=MultiCustomer.CompanyID left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail as SuppCC on SuppCC.CodeCombinationID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode --AND SuppCC.ChartofAccountID= AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_ChartofAccountID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID left join SET_CostCenter on SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = AP_PaymentHeader.CostCentreID and SET_CostCenter.Status = 1
left join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID = AP_PaymentHeader.FiscalID and GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1
left join GL_TransactionDetail on GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID and GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionDetail.Status=1 and GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Left Join INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = GL_TransactionDetail.IncurredOnID left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
where [AP_PaymentHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID and [AP_PaymentHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID {0} union all select distinct '' as IncurredOn, AP_PaymentBanksDetail.TransactionType, ap_paymentHeader.PaymentID,[AP_PaymentHeader].[DocumentTypeID],[AP_PaymentHeader].[DocumentNo] ,BA.PaymentCCID as AccountCodes,ltrim(rtrim(BankDesc.Description)) as CodeDescription ,case AP_PaymentBanksDetail.TransactionType when 'Debit' then abs(AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount) else AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount * -1 end as Amount ,AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Comments as Narration ,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.PayeeName , SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AP_PaymentHeader.Reference from ap_paymentHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID
left join AR_SET_BankAccount on AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID = AP_PaymentHeader.BankAccountID --and AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID left join AR_SET_BankBranch on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AP_PaymentHeader.CustomerBankBranchID left join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID left join AP_PaymentBanksDetail on AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Status=1
left join AR_SET_BankBranch BB on BB.BankBranchID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankBranchID left join AR_SET_BankAccount BA on BA.BankAccountID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID and BA.BankBranchID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankBranchID --and BA.CompanyID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID and BA.PeriodID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Status=1 left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail as BankDesc on BankDesc.CodeCombinationID = BA.PaymentCCID
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID left join SET_CostCenter on SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = AP_PaymentHeader.CostCentreID and SET_CostCenter.Status = 1
where [AP_PaymentHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID and [AP_PaymentHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID {0} union all select distinct INV_Item.Description as IncurredOn, AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.TransactionType, ap_paymentHeader.PaymentID,[AP_PaymentHeader].[DocumentTypeID],[AP_PaymentHeader].[DocumentNo] ,AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID as AccountCodes ,ltrim(rtrim(GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description)) as CodeDescription ,case AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.TransactionType when 'Debit' then abs(AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.amount) else AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.amount *-1 end as AccountDtlAmount ,AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Narration ,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.PayeeName , SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AP_PaymentHeader.Reference from ap_paymentHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID

SELECT distinct Ap_paymentHeader.DocumentNo, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentInvoicesID, AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID, AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber AS InvoiceNo, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate,-- AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.Amount AS InvoiceAmount, AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid + ( isnull((select sum(isnull(Amount,0)) from AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status = 1 and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Narration not like 'GST' Group By AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID,AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID ),0) )
+ isnull(( (select sum(isnull(Convert(decimal(18,6),TaxAmountOnNet),0)) from AR_InvoiceDetail where AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 Group By AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID, AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID, AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID ) ),0) AS InvoiceAmount
,AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.Amount
FROM AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail INNER JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 inner join Ap_paymentHeader on Ap_paymentHeader.PaymentID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID AND Ap_paymentHeader.Status=1 and Ap_paymentHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID and Ap_paymentHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID and Ap_paymentHeader.ReversalDate is null and ReversalID is null inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID left join AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail on AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID

data.name: Query_GetPaymentReceiptReportDataRSM
data.value:
select AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate as PostingDate, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, CASE AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode When 1 then 'Approved' When 2 then 'Cancelled' When 3 then 'Effective' When 4 then 'Expired' When 5 then 'In Process' When 6 then 'Incomplete' When 7 then 'Pre Approved' When 8 then 'Rejected' When 9 then 'Requires Reapproval' When 10 then 'Returned' when 11 then 'Open' When 12 then 'Release For Approve' When 13 then 'Partially Approved' End AS CurrentStatus, AP_PaymentHeader.Reference as DocumentReference, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo as ChequeNo, AP_PaymentHeader.ReceiptDate as ChequeDate, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode, CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as SupplierName, AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 as SupplierAddress, AR_SET_Customer.ZipCode as SupplierZipCode, AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber as SupplierPhone, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber, AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber, CitySupp.CityName as SupplierCity, AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchName, IsNull(AP_PaymentHeader.Comments, '') + IsNull(AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments, '') As Comments, ISNULL(AP_PaymentHeader.WithHoldingTax, 0) as WithHoldingTax, isnull(AP_PaymentHeader.Amount, 0) as Amount, isnull(BankTD.Amount, 0) BankAmount, --isnull(GL_TransactionHeader.ControlCredit, AP_PaymentHeader.Amount) VenderAmount, (AP_PaymentHeader.Amount) VenderAmount, CASE (ISNULL((Select SUM(AP_PaymentTaxes.TaxAmount) FROM AP_PaymentTaxes WHERE AP_PaymentTaxes.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID), 0)) when 0 then Isnull(TaxTD.Amount, 0) else (ISNULL((Select SUM(AP_PaymentTaxes.TaxAmount) FROM AP_PaymentTaxes WHERE AP_PaymentTaxes.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID), 0)) END AS TaxAmount, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, CASE AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName when null then AR_SET_Bank.BankName end as BankName, CASE WHEN DocumentType like '%Cash Withdrawal%' THEN 'Cash' when DocumentType like '%Bank Charges%' then AR_SET_Bank.BankName when DocumentType like '%Payment Transfer%' then 'Bank Transfer' else '' end as Reciever, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber as PODocNo, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate as inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID left join SET_CostCenter on SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = AP_PaymentHeader.CostCentreID and SET_CostCenter.Status = 1 where [AP_PaymentHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID and [AP_PaymentHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID {0} union all select distinct AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.TransactionType, ap_paymentHeader.PaymentID,[AP_PaymentHeader].[DocumentTypeID],[AP_PaymentHeader].[DocumentNo] ,AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID as AccountCodes ,ltrim(rtrim(GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description)) as CodeDescription ,case AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.TransactionType when 'Debit' then abs(AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.amount) else AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.amount *-1 end as AccountDtlAmount ,AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Narration ,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.PayeeName , SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AP_PaymentHeader.Reference from ap_paymentHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID left join AP_Payment_AccountsDetail on AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Status=1 left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID left join SET_CostCenter on SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = AP_PaymentHeader.CostCentreID and SET_CostCenter.Status = 1 where [AP_PaymentHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID and [AP_PaymentHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID {0}
union all select distinct GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType, ap_paymentHeader.PaymentID,[AP_PaymentHeader].[DocumentTypeID],[AP_PaymentHeader].[DocumentNo] ,GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID as AccountCodes ,ltrim(rtrim(GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description)) as CodeDescription ,case GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType when 'Debit' then abs(GL_TransactionDetail.amount) else GL_TransactionDetail.amount *-1 end as AccountDtlAmount ,GL_TransactionDetail.Narration ,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.PayeeName, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AP_PaymentHeader.Reference from ap_paymentHeader
inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and (SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%advance against PO%' OR SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%payment against vendor invoice%')
left join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID = AP_PaymentHeader.FiscalID and GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1
left join GL_TransactionDetail on GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID and GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionDetail.Status=1 and GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit'
left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID left join SET_CostCenter on SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = AP_PaymentHeader.CostCentreID and SET_CostCenter.Status = 1 where [AP_PaymentHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID and [AP_PaymentHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID {0}
) as TAB where AccountCodes is not null and TAB.TransactionType = 'Debit' and Amount <> 0
Group by TAB.TransactionType, TAB.DocumentType, TAB.DocumentNo, TAB.DocumentTypeID
------ Supplier Grid Data ---- select distinct MultiCustomer.CustomerID as BPID, ap_paymentHeader.PaymentID,[AP_PaymentHeader].[DocumentTypeID],[AP_PaymentHeader].[DocumentNo] ,ltrim(rtrim(MultiCustomer.CustomerName)) as CustomerName,AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType,AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Narration ,isnull(AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount, 0) as Amount,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentSupplierID, AP_PaymentHeader.PayeeName , SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AP_PaymentHeader.Reference from ap_paymentHeader left join AP_PaymentSupplierDetail on AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Status=1 inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID left join AR_SET_Customer MultiCustomer on MultiCustomer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = MultiCustomer.CompanyID
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
left join SET_CostCenter on SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = AP_PaymentHeader.CostCentreID and SET_CostCenter.Status = 1
where [AP_PaymentHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID and [AP_PaymentHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID {0} ORDER BY AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentSupplierID asc

----- Invoice Grid Data ---------
SELECT distinct Ap_paymentHeader.DocumentNo, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentInvoicesID, AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID, AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber AS InvoiceNo, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate,-- AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.Amount AS InvoiceAmount, AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid + ( isnull((select sum(isnull(Amount,0)) from AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status = 1 and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Narration not like 'GST' Group By AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID,AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID ),0) )
+ isnull(( (select sum(isnull(Convert(decimal(18,6),TaxAmountOnNet),0)) from AR_InvoiceDetail where AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 Group By AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID, AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID, AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID ) ),0) AS InvoiceAmount
,AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.Amount
FROM AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail INNER JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 inner join Ap_paymentHeader on Ap_paymentHeader.PaymentID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID AND Ap_paymentHeader.Status=1 and Ap_paymentHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID and Ap_paymentHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID and Ap_paymentHeader.ReversalDate is null and ReversalID is null inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID left join AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail on AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
WHERE [AP_PaymentHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID and [AP_PaymentHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.Status = 1 and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID {0}

select AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate as PostingDate, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, CASE AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode When 1 then 'Approved' When 2 then 'Cancelled' When 3 then 'Effective' When 4 then 'Expired' When 5 then 'In Process' When 6 then 'Incomplete' When 7 then 'Pre Approved' When 8 then 'Rejected' When 9 then 'Requires Reapproval' When 10 then 'Returned' when 11 then 'Open' When 12 then 'Release For Approve' When 13 then 'Partially Approved' End AS CurrentStatus, AP_PaymentHeader.Reference as DocumentReference, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo as ChequeNo, AP_PaymentHeader.ReceiptDate as ChequeDate, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode, CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as SupplierName, AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 as SupplierAddress, AR_SET_Customer.ZipCode as SupplierZipCode, AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber as SupplierPhone, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber, AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber, CitySupp.CityName as SupplierCity, AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchName, IsNull(AP_PaymentHeader.Comments, '') + IsNull(AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments, '') As Comments, ISNULL(AP_PaymentHeader.WithHoldingTax, 0) as WithHoldingTax, isnull(AP_PaymentHeader.Amount, 0) as Amount, isnull(BankTD.Amount, 0) BankAmount, isnull(GL_TransactionHeader.ControlCredit, AP_PaymentHeader.Amount) VenderAmount, CASE (ISNULL((Select SUM(AP_PaymentTaxes.TaxAmount) FROM AP_PaymentTaxes WHERE AP_PaymentTaxes.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID), 0)) when 0 then Isnull(TaxTD.Amount, 0) else (ISNULL((Select SUM(AP_PaymentTaxes.TaxAmount) FROM AP_PaymentTaxes WHERE AP_PaymentTaxes.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID), 0)) END AS TaxAmount, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber, CASE AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName when null then AR_SET_Bank.BankName end as BankName, CASE WHEN DocumentType like '%Cash Withdrawal%' THEN 'Cash' when DocumentType like '%Bank Charges%' then AR_SET_Bank.BankName when DocumentType like '%Payment Transfer%' then 'Bank Transfer' else '' end as Reciever, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber as PODocNo, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate as PODate, BA.BankAccountName as DetailBankAccountName, BB.BankBranchName as DetailBankBranchName, SET_ReceiptMethod.ReceiptMethodName, AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount as DetailAmount, AP_PaymentBanksDetail.TransactionType, AP_PaymentBanksDetail.InstrumentNo , (Case ( Select COUNT(SerialNo) as count from SET_Parameter where FieldName='VoucherPrint' and IsVisible=1) when 1 then (Case isnull(Set_DocumentType.Description,'') when '' then convert(varchar(24),ap_paymentHeader.DocumentNo) else substring(convert(varchar(20),year(ap_paymentHeader.DocumentDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),ap_paymentHeader.DocumentNo) end ) else convert(varchar(24),ap_paymentHeader.DocumentNo) end )as VoucherNumber ,Set_DocumentType.Description as DocDescription from AP_PaymentHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID left JOIN GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo left join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID --and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID left join AR_SET_BankAccount on AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID = AP_PaymentHeader.BankAccountID --and AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail as BankCC on BankCC.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PaymentCCID and BankCC.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID left join GL_TransactionDetail as BankTD on BankTD.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PaymentCCID and BankTD.SourceHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and BankTD.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and BankTD.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = BankTD.TransactionID left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail as VenderCC on VenderCC.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerAccountCCID and VenderCC.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID left join GL_TransactionDetail as VenderTD on VenderTD.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerAccountCCID and VenderTD.SourceHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and VenderTD.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and VenderTD.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = VenderTD.TransactionID left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail as TaxCC on TaxCC.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_Customer.SuppliesTaxCOA and TaxCC.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID left join GL_TransactionDetail as TaxTD on TaxTD.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_Customer.SuppliesTaxCOA and TaxTD.SourceHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and TaxTD.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and TaxTD.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = TaxTD.TransactionID left join AR_SET_BankBranch on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AP_PaymentHeader.CustomerBankBranchID left join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID left Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID left Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId Left Join SET_City AS CitySupp ON CitySupp.CityID = AR_SET_Customer.CityID Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID LEFT JOIN AP_PurchaseOrderHeader ON AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.SourceHeaderID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID left join AP_PaymentBanksDetail on AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID left join AR_SET_BankBranch BB on BB.BankBranchID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankBranchID left join AR_SET_BankAccount BA on BA.BankAccountID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID and BA.CompanyID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID and BA.PeriodID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID left join SET_ReceiptMethod on SET_ReceiptMethod.ReceiptMethodID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentMethodID left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail as SuppCC on SuppCC.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerAccountCCID left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail as BankDesc on BankDesc.CodeCombinationID = BA.PaymentCCID where AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID {0} order by AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo ASC
