select GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description as TaxDescription, AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount as TaxesAmount, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, (isnull(VenderCC.Description, '') + ': ' + isnull(TaxCC.Description, '') + ' Bank: ' + isnull(BankCC.Description, '')) as Vendordescription, sum(AP_PaymentBanksDetail.amount) as amount, AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PaymentDetailAccountID from AP_PaymentHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID left JOIN GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo left join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID --and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID left join AP_PaymentBanksDetail on AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID left join AR_SET_BankAccount on AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID = AP_PaymentHeader.BankAccountID --and AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail as BankCC on BankCC.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PaymentCCID and BankCC.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID left join GL_TransactionDetail as BankTD on BankTD.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PaymentCCID and BankTD.SourceHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and BankTD.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and BankTD.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = BankTD.TransactionID left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail as VenderCC on VenderCC.CodeCombinationID = [AR_SET_Customer].CustomerAccountCCID and VenderCC.CompanyID = [AP_PaymentHeader].CompanyID left join GL_TransactionDetail as VenderTD on VenderTD.CodeCombinationID = [AR_SET_Customer].CustomerAccountCCID and VenderTD.SourceHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and VenderTD.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and VenderTD.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and [GL_TransactionHeader].[TransactionID] = VenderTD.[TransactionID] left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail as TaxCC on TaxCC.CodeCombinationID = [AR_SET_Customer].SuppliesTaxCOA and TaxCC.CompanyID = [AP_PaymentHeader].CompanyID left join GL_TransactionDetail as TaxTD on TaxTD.CodeCombinationID = [AR_SET_Customer].SuppliesTaxCOA and TaxTD.SourceHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and TaxTD.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and TaxTD.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and [GL_TransactionHeader].[TransactionID] = TaxTD.[TransactionID]
left join AP_Payment_AccountsDetail on AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PaymentHeaderID =AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.CompanyID =AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PeriodID =AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID
left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID --and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID = AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.CompanyID where [AP_PaymentHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID and [AP_PaymentHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID {0} group by GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description, AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, VenderCC.Description,TaxCC.Description,BankCC.Description,AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PaymentDetailAccountID order by [AP_PaymentHeader].[DocumentNo], AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PaymentDetailAccountID ASC ------------------------- GL Voucher --------------------------------------- select DocumentType,[DocumentNo],[DocumentTypeID],AccountCodes, CodeDescription, Amount, Narration,VoucherNumber ,DocDescription from ( select distinct ap_paymentHeader.PaymentID,[AP_PaymentHeader].[DocumentTypeID],[AP_PaymentHeader].[DocumentNo] ,AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID as AccountCodes ,ltrim(rtrim(SuppCC.Description)) as CodeDescription ,isnull(AP_PaymentHeader.Amount, 0) as Amount ,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType ,AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Narration , (Case ( Select COUNT(SerialNo) as count from SET_Parameter where FieldName='VoucherPrint' and IsVisible=1) when 1 then (Case isnull(Set_DocumentType.Description,'') when '' then convert(varchar(24),ap_paymentHeader.DocumentNo) else Set_DocumentType.Description+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(ap_paymentHeader.DocumentDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),ap_paymentHeader.DocumentNo) end ) else convert(varchar(24),ap_paymentHeader.DocumentNo) end )as VoucherNumber ,Set_DocumentType.Description as DocDescription from ap_paymentHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID --and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID left join AP_PaymentBanksDetail on AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID left join AR_SET_BankBranch BB on BB.BankBranchID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankBranchID left join AR_SET_BankAccount BA on BA.BankAccountID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.BankAccountID and BA.CompanyID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID and BA.PeriodID = AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID left JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID=AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID=AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail as SuppCC on SuppCC.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID AND SuppCC.ChartofAccountID= AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_ChartofAccountID left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail as BankDesc on BankDesc.CodeCombinationID = BA.PaymentCCID Left JOIN AP_Payment_AccountsDetail ON AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PaymentHeaderID = ap_paymentHeader.PaymentID AND AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = ap_paymentHeader.CompanyID AND AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = ap_paymentHeader.PeriodID AND AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Status=1 where [AP_PaymentHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID and [AP_PaymentHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID {0} union all select ap_paymentHeader.PaymentID,[AP_PaymentHeader].[DocumentTypeID],[AP_PaymentHeader].[DocumentNo] ,AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID as AccountCodes ,ltrim(rtrim(SuppCC.Description)) as CodeDescription ,case AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType when 'Credit' then isnull(AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount, 0) *-1 when 'Debit' then isnull(AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount, 0) else 0 end as Amount ,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType ,'' as Narration , (Case ( Select COUNT(SerialNo) as count from SET_Parameter where FieldName='VoucherPrint' and IsVisible=1) when 1 then (Case isnull(Set_DocumentType.Description,'') when '' then convert(varchar(24),ap_paymentHeader.DocumentNo) else Set_DocumentType.Description+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(ap_paymentHeader.DocumentDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),ap_paymentHeader.DocumentNo) end ) else convert(varchar(24),ap_paymentHeader.DocumentNo) end ) as VoucherNumber ,Set_DocumentType.Description as DocDescription from ap_paymentHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID inner join AP_PaymentSupplierDetail on AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Status = 1 left join AR_SET_Customer MultiCustomer on MultiCustomer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID -- AND MultiCustomer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = MultiCustomer.CompanyID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = MultiCustomer.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Status=1 left JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID=AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID=AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID=AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail as SuppCC on SuppCC.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID AND SuppCC.ChartofAccountID= AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_ChartofAccountID where [AP_PaymentHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID and [AP_PaymentHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID {0} union all select distinct ap_paymentHeader.PaymentID,[AP_PaymentHeader].[DocumentTypeID],[AP_PaymentHeader].[DocumentNo] ,BA.PaymentCCID as AccountCodes,ltrim(rtrim(BankDesc.Description)) as CodeDescription ,case AP_PaymentBanksDetail.TransactionType when 'Debit' then abs(AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount) else AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Amount * -1 end as Amount ,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType ,BA.BankAccountName +'-'+ InstrumentNo as Narration , (Case ( Select COUNT(SerialNo) as count from SET_Parameter where FieldName='VoucherPrint' and IsVisible=1) when 1 then (Case isnull(Set_DocumentType.Description,'') when '' then convert(varchar(24),ap_paymentHeader.DocumentNo) else Set_DocumentType.Description+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(ap_paymentHeader.DocumentDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),ap_paymentHeader.DocumentNo) end ) else convert(varchar(24),ap_paymentHeader.DocumentNo) end )as VoucherNumber ,Set_DocumentType.Description as DocDescription from ap_paymentHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID left join AR_SET_BankAccount on AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID = AP_PaymentHeader.BankAccountID --and AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID left join AR_SET_BankBranch on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AP_PaymentHeader.CustomerBankBranchID left join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID left join AP_PaymentBanksDetail on AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID left ap_paymentHeader.PaymentID,[AP_PaymentHeader].[DocumentTypeID],[AP_PaymentHeader].[DocumentNo] ,AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID as AccountCodes ,ltrim(rtrim(GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description)) as CodeDescription ,case AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.TransactionType when 'Debit' then abs(AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.amount) else AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.amount *-1 end as AccountDtlAmount ,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType ,AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Narration , (Case ( Select COUNT(SerialNo) as count from SET_Parameter where FieldName='VoucherPrint' and IsVisible=1) when 1 then (Case isnull(Set_DocumentType.Description,'') when '' then convert(varchar(24),ap_paymentHeader.DocumentNo) else Set_DocumentType.Description+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(ap_paymentHeader.DocumentDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),ap_paymentHeader.DocumentNo) end ) else convert(varchar(24),ap_paymentHeader.DocumentNo) end )as VoucherNumber ,Set_DocumentType.Description as DocDescription from ap_paymentHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID left join AP_Payment_AccountsDetail on AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID where [AP_PaymentHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID and [AP_PaymentHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID {0} ) as TAB where AccountCodes is not null order by Amount desc ------ Supplier Grid Data ---- select distinct ap_paymentHeader.PaymentID,[AP_PaymentHeader].[DocumentTypeID],[AP_PaymentHeader].[DocumentNo] ,ltrim(rtrim(MultiCustomer.CustomerName)) as CustomerName,AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType,AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Narration ,isnull(AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount, 0) as Amount,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentSupplierID from ap_paymentHeader left join AP_PaymentSupplierDetail on AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID left join AR_SET_Customer MultiCustomer on MultiCustomer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = MultiCustomer.CompanyID where [AP_PaymentHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID and [AP_PaymentHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID {0} ORDER BY AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentSupplierID asc

inner join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID --and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID = AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.CompanyID Left JOIn AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail ON AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID=AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID=AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.status=1 left JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status =1 inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = ap_PaymentHeader.VendorID --and ar_set_customer.CompanyID = ap_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and ar_set_customer.PeriodID = ap_PaymentHeader.PeriodID

left join AP_PaymentSupplierDetail on AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.paymentHeaderID = ap_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = ap_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = ap_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.status = 1 and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentSupplierID = 1

left join Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail on Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.invoiceID and Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.status = 1 and Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceCustomerID = 1
left join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID --and ar_set_customer.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID and ar_set_customer.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID
left Join SET_City on SET_City.CityID = ar_set_customer.CityID And SET_City.Status=1 and ar_set_customer.CityID <> -1
inner join Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail on Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.invoiceID and Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.status = 1
inner join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID --and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID = Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CompanyID
where Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and convert(date,Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate) between @FromDate and @ToDate and isnull(GL_CodeCombinationDetail.SaleWithHoldingTaxFlag,0) = 1 {1}
Union All
------ Multi supplier Amount from Supplier grid Select PaymentID,DocumentType,ChartOfAccountCode,CustomerName,NTNNumber,STRNNumber,CNICNumber,InvoiceNumber,VoucherNo,PaymentDate,TaxRate ,(ValueWithOutWHTax - Amount_WHTax)PaymentAmount,TransactionType,Amount_WHTax,ValueWithOutWHTax,AddressLine1,CityID,CityName,DetailID ,TaxableAmount,ChequeNo from ( select ap_PaymentHeader.PaymentID,SET_DocumentType.documentTYpe,GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID as ChartOfAccountCode, case when AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName is null then 'JOUNRAL VOUCHER' else AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName end as CustomerName ,(Case when AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber='' then null else substring(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber ,0,8)+'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber ,8,len( AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber )-1) end )as NTNNumber ,(Case when AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber='' then null else substring(AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,0,3)+'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,3,2) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,5,4) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,9,3) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,12,len( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber )-1) end )as STRNNumber ,(Case when AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber='' then null else substring(AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber,0,6) +'-'+ substring(AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber,6,7) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber ,13,len( AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber )-1) end )as CNICNumber , ap_PaymentHeader.Reference as InvoiceNumber,ap_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo as VoucherNo ,ap_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate as PaymentDate ,case when AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName is null then 100 else
--case when AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount is not null then --case when (ISNULL(ap_PaymentHeader.Amount,0)) > 0 then (AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount / NULLIF((ISNULL(ap_PaymentHeader.Amount,0)),0))*100 else 0 end --ELSE -- case when (ISNULL(ap_PaymentHeader.Amount,0)) > 0 then (AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount / NULLIF((ISNULL(ap_PaymentHeader.Amount,0)),0))*100 else 0 end
-- END AR_SET_Tax.TaxRate end
as TaxRate ,case when AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName is null then AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount else SUM(AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount) end as PaymentAmount, ISNULL(AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.TransactionType,AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType ) AS TransactionType ,(case when isnull(GL_CodeCombinationDetail.SaleWithHoldingTaxFlag,0) = 1 then CASE when AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType ='Debit' then SUM((AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount)*-1 ) else SUM(AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount) end end ) as Amount_WHTax , case when AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName is null then 0 else AP_PaymentHeader.ControlDebit
--case when AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount is not null then --NullIF((ap_PaymentHeader.Amount - (ap_PaymentHeader.Amount * case when (ISNULL(ap_PaymentHeader.Amount,0)) > 0 then((AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount / ap_PaymentHeader.Amount) * 100) else 0 end / 100)),0) --ELSE --NullIF((ap_PaymentHeader.Amount - (ap_PaymentHeader.Amount * case when (ISNULL(ap_PaymentHeader.Amount,0)) > 0 then ((AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount / ap_PaymentHeader.Amount) * 100) else 0 end / 100)),0)
-- END end
as ValueWithOutWHTax ,AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1, AR_SET_Customer.CityID , SET_City.CityName ,AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PaymentDetailAccountID as DetailID ,SUM(ISNULL(InvoiceAmount,0)) as TaxableAmount ,(SELECT STUFF ( ( SELECT ',' + s.InstrumentNo FROM AP_PaymentBanksDetail s where s.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and s.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and s.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and s.Status = 1 FOR XML PATH('') ), 1, 1, '' ) AS t) as ChequeNo
from ap_PaymentHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = ap_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = ap_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = ap_PaymentHeader.PeriodID
left join AP_PaymentSupplierDetail on AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.paymentHeaderID = ap_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = ap_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = ap_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.status = 1 --and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentSupplierID = 1
inner join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode --AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = '02-02-06-002-001' --and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID = AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.CompanyID
Left join AP_Payment_AccountsDetail on AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.paymentHeaderID = ap_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = ap_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = ap_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.status = 1 and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID
INNER join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID --and ar_set_customer.CompanyID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID and ar_set_customer.PeriodID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID left Join SET_City on SET_City.CityID = ar_set_customer.CityID And SET_City.Status=1 and ar_set_customer.CityID <> -1 left join AR_SET_Tax on AR_SET_Tax.TaxID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TaxID
left Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID= AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartner On AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID=AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode
where ap_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and ap_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and convert(date,ap_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate) between @FromDate and @ToDate and isnull(GL_CodeCombinationDetail.SaleWithHoldingTaxFlag,0) = 1 AND ap_PaymentHeader.Status=1 And ap_PaymentHeader.StatusCode=1 {1} {2}
group by ap_PaymentHeader.PaymentID,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber ,AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber,CNICNumber,ap_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo,ap_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate,AR_SET_Tax.TaxRate,AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount ,AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.TransactionType,AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType,GL_CodeCombinationDetail.SaleWithHoldingTaxFlag,ap_PaymentHeader.ControlDebit ,AddressLine1,AR_Set_Customer.CityID,CityName,PaymentDetailAccountID ,ap_PaymentHeader.Reference,ap_PaymentHeader.CompanyID,ap_PaymentHeader.PeriodID
) as t
) as TAB {0}

,ap_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo as VoucherNo ,ap_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate as PaymentDate ,case when (ISNULL(ap_PaymentHeader.Amount,0)) > 0 then (AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount / NULLIF((ISNULL(ap_PaymentHeader.Amount,0)),0))*100 else 0 end as TaxRate
,ap_PaymentHeader.Amount as PaymentAmount ,AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.TransactionType ,(CASE when AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.TransactionType ='Debit' then (AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount)*-1 else (AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount) end ) as Amount_WHTax ,ap_PaymentHeader.Amount - (ap_PaymentHeader.Amount * case when (ISNULL(ap_PaymentHeader.Amount,0)) > 0 then((AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount / NULLIF((ap_PaymentHeader.Amount),0) * 100) / 100) else 0 end) as ValueWithOutWHTax ,AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1, AR_SET_Customer.CityID , SET_City.CityName ,AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PaymentDetailAccountID as DetailID,0 as TaxableAmount ,(SELECT STUFF ( ( SELECT ',' + s.InstrumentNo FROM AP_PaymentBanksDetail s where s.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and s.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and s.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and s.Status = 1 FOR XML PATH('') ), 1, 1, '' ) AS t) as ChequeNo ,AR_SET_Customer.ContactPersonName from ap_PaymentHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = ap_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = ap_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = ap_PaymentHeader.PeriodID left join DocumentTypesGroup on DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = SET_DocumentType.GroupID and DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID
inner join AP_Payment_AccountsDetail on AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.paymentHeaderID = ap_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = ap_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = ap_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.status = 1
inner join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID --and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID = AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.CompanyID Left JOIn AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail ON AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID=AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID=AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.status=1 left JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status =1 inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = ap_PaymentHeader.VendorID --and ar_set_customer.CompanyID = ap_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and ar_set_customer.PeriodID = ap_PaymentHeader.PeriodID
left Join SET_City on SET_City.CityID = ar_set_customer.CityID And SET_City.Status=1 and ar_set_customer.CityID <> -1
inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID= ap_PaymentHeader.VendorID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = ap_PaymentHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartner On AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID=AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode

as ValueWithOutWHTax ,AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1, AR_SET_Customer.CityID , SET_City.CityName ,AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PaymentDetailAccountID as DetailID ,SUM(ISNULL(InvoiceAmount,0)) as TaxableAmount ,(SELECT STUFF ( ( SELECT ',' + s.InstrumentNo FROM AP_PaymentBanksDetail s where s.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and s.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and s.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and s.Status = 1 FOR XML PATH('') ), 1, 1, '' ) AS t) as ChequeNo
from ap_PaymentHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = ap_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = ap_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = ap_PaymentHeader.PeriodID
left join AP_PaymentSupplierDetail on AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.paymentHeaderID = ap_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = ap_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = ap_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.status = 1 --and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentSupplierID = 1
inner join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode --AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = '02-02-06-002-001' --and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID = AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.CompanyID
Left join AP_Payment_AccountsDetail on AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.paymentHeaderID = ap_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = ap_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = ap_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.status = 1 and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID
INNER join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID --and ar_set_customer.CompanyID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID and ar_set_customer.PeriodID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID left Join SET_City on SET_City.CityID = ar_set_customer.CityID And SET_City.Status=1 and ar_set_customer.CityID <> -1 left join AR_SET_Tax on AR_SET_Tax.TaxID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TaxID
inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartner On AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID=AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode
where ap_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and ap_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and convert(date,ap_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate) between @FromDate and @ToDate and isnull(GL_CodeCombinationDetail.WithHoldingTaxFlag,0) = 1 AND ap_PaymentHeader.Status=1 And ap_PaymentHeader.StatusCode=1 {1} {2}
group by ap_PaymentHeader.PaymentID,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber ,AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber,CNICNumber,ap_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo,ap_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate,AR_SET_Tax.TaxRate,AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount ,AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.TransactionType,AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType,GL_CodeCombinationDetail.WithHoldingTaxFlag,ap_PaymentHeader.ControlDebit ,AddressLine1,AR_Set_Customer.CityID,CityName,PaymentDetailAccountID ,ap_PaymentHeader.Reference,ap_PaymentHeader.CompanyID,ap_PaymentHeader.PeriodID
) as t
union all

,convert(varchar(50),IMP_CustomClearing.CustomClearingID) as VoucherNo ,null as PaymentDate ,0 as TaxRate
,0 as PaymentAmount ,'' as TransactionType ,0 as Amount_WHTax ,0 as ValueWithOutWHTax ,AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1, AR_SET_Customer.CityID , SET_City.CityName ,0 as DetailID,Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.SalesTax as TaxableAmount ,'' as ChequeNo
from IMP_CustomClearing
inner join Fabric_ImportCostingHeader on Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.CostingID = IMP_CustomClearing.CostingID and Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.CompanyID = IMP_CustomClearing.CompanyID and Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.PeriodID = IMP_CustomClearing.PeriodID and Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.Status = 1 inner join Fabric_ImportCostingDetail on Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.CostingID = Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.CostingID and Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.CompanyID = Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.CompanyID and Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.Status = 1 and Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.RD is null

{2}
) as TAB {0}

,ap_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo as VoucherNo ,ap_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate as PaymentDate ,0 as TaxRate
,ap_PaymentHeader.Amount as PaymentAmount ,'' as TransactionType ,0 as Amount_WHTax ,ap_PaymentHeader.Amount as ValueWithOutWHTax ,AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1, AR_SET_Customer.CityID , SET_City.CityName ,AR_SET_Customer.ContactPersonName from ap_PaymentHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = ap_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = ap_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = ap_PaymentHeader.PeriodID
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = ap_PaymentHeader.VendorID and ar_set_customer.PeriodID = ap_PaymentHeader.PeriodID inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID= AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = ap_PaymentHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartner On AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID=AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID=1 inner join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID --and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID = AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.CompanyID Left JOIn AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail ON AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID=AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID=AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.status=1 left JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status =1
left Join SET_City on SET_City.CityID = ar_set_customer.CityID And SET_City.Status=1 and ar_set_customer.CityID <> -1
where ap_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and ap_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and convert(date,ap_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate) between @FromDate and @ToDate AND ap_PaymentHeader.Status=1 And ap_PaymentHeader.StatusCode=1 {1} {2}

and ar_set_customer.PeriodID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID left Join SET_City on SET_City.CityID = ar_set_customer.CityID And SET_City.Status=1 and ar_set_customer.CityID <> -1

--,Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.TransactionType --,0 As Amount_WHTax --,Sal_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid as ValueWithOutWHTax --,AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1, AR_SET_Customer.CityID , SET_City.CityName --from Sal_InvoiceHeader --inner join Set_DocumentType on Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType --and Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID --and Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
--left join Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail on Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.invoiceID --and Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID --and Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID --and Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.status = 1 and Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceCustomerID = 1
--left join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID ----and ar_set_customer.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID --and ar_set_customer.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID

and ar_set_customer.PeriodID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID left Join SET_City on SET_City.CityID = ar_set_customer.CityID And SET_City.Status=1 and ar_set_customer.CityID <> -1

data.name: Query_PurchaseRegisterSugarUnit
data.value:
Select CustomerName, NTNNumber, CNICNumber , InvoiceReceivedDate ,VendorReferenceNumber , DocumentType, isnull(sum(AmountPaid),0) as AmountPaid , isnull(Sum(TaxRate),0) as TaxRate, isnull(Sum(TaxAmount),0) as TaxAmount, isnull(sum(WithTaxAmount),0) as WithTaxAmount, AddressLine1, CityID, CityName, Description, isnull(sum(QuantityInvoiced),0) as QuantityInvoiced, isnull(sum(UnitPrice),0) as UnitPrice from ( Select distinct AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName ,(Case when AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber='' then null else substring(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber ,0,8)+'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber ,8,len( AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber )-1) end )as NTNNumber ,(Case when AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber='' then null else substring(AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,0,3)+'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,3,2) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,5,4) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,9,3) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,12,len( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber )-1) end )as STRNNumber ,(Case when AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber='' then null else substring(AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber,0,6) +'-'+ substring(AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber,6,7) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber ,13,len( AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber )-1) end )as CNICNumber ,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceReceivedDate,AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorReferenceNumber,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber as VoucherNo,Set_DocumentType.DocumentType , Case When AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' Then ABS((AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid)) - AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid * max(isnull(AR_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0)) / (100 + max(isnull(AR_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0))) else sum(AR_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount) end as AmountPaid,
max(isnull(AR_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0)) as TaxRate,
Case When AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' Then AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid * max(isnull(AR_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0)) / (100 + max(isnull(AR_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0))) else (sum(AR_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount) * isnull(max(AR_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount),0) / 100) end As TaxAmount
,(sum(AR_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount) + (sum(AR_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount) * isnull(max(AR_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount),0) / 100)) as WithTaxAmount
,AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1, AR_SET_Customer.CityID , SET_City.CityName ,AR_InvoiceHeader.Description, isnull(SUM(AR_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced),0) as QuantityInvoiced, SUM(AR_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice) as UnitPrice
from AR_InvoiceHeader inner join AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.FiscalID = AR_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID and AR_InvoiceDetail.Status=1
Left Join AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail on AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.FiscalID = AR_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID AND AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Status = 1
inner join Set_DocumentType on Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType and Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID --and ar_set_customer.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and ar_set_customer.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
left Join SET_City on SET_City.CityID = ar_set_customer.CityID And SET_City.Status=1 and ar_set_customer.CityID <> -1
inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode
where AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceReceivedDate between @FromDate and @ToDate AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status=1 and isnull(AR_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0) > 0 {1} {2} group by AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceReceivedDate,AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorReferenceNumber, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.TransactionType ,Set_DocumentType.DocumentType,AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber,AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber,AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber, AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1, AR_SET_Customer.CityID , SET_City.CityName,AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid ,AR_InvoiceHeader.Description,AR_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced, AR_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice
union all
Select distinct AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName ,(Case when AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber='' then null else substring(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber ,0,8)+'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber ,8,len( AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber )-1) end )as NTNNumber ,(Case when AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber='' then null else substring(AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,0,3)+'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,3,2) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,5,4) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,9,3) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,12,len( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber )-1) end )as STRNNumber ,(Case when AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber='' then null else substring(AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber,0,6) +'-'+ substring(AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber,6,7) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber ,13,len( AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber )-1) end )as CNICNumber ,IMP_CustomClearing.CreateDate as InvoiceReceivedDate,'' as VendorReferenceNumber,IMP_CustomClearing.CostingID as VoucherNo,'Custom Clearing' as DocumentType , TotalAmount as AmountPaid,
0 as TaxRate,
IMP_CustomClearing.GSTAmount As TaxAmount
,0 as WithTaxAmount
,AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1, AR_SET_Customer.CityID , SET_City.CityName ,'' as Description, 0 as QuantityInvoiced, 0 as UnitPrice from IMP_CustomClearing
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = IMP_CustomClearing.ClearingAgentID and ar_set_customer.PeriodID = IMP_CustomClearing.PeriodID
left Join SET_City on SET_City.CityID = ar_set_customer.CityID And SET_City.Status=1 and ar_set_customer.CityID <> -1
inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = IMP_CustomClearing.ClearingAgentID inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode
where IMP_CustomClearing.CompanyID = @CompanyID and IMP_CustomClearing.PeriodID = @PeriodID and IMP_CustomClearing.CreateDate between @FromDate and @ToDate AND IMP_CustomClearing.Status=1 and isnull(IMP_CustomClearing.GSTAmount,0) > 0 {1} {2}
union all
Select distinct AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName ,(Case when AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber='' then null else substring(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber ,0,8)+'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber ,8,len( AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber )-1) end )as NTNNumber ,(Case when AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber='' then null else substring(AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,0,3)+'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,3,2) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,5,4) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,9,3) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,12,len( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber )-1) end )as STRNNumber ,(Case when AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber='' then null else substring(AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber,0,6) +'-'+ substring(AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber,6,7) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber ,13,len( AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber )-1) end )as CNICNumber ,IMP_CustomClearing.CreateDate as InvoiceReceivedDate,'' as VendorReferenceNumber,IMP_CustomClearing.CostingID as VoucherNo,'Custom Clearing' as DocumentType , TotalAmount as AmountPaid,
0 as TaxRate,
Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.IncomeTax As TaxAmount
,0 as WithTaxAmount
,AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1, AR_SET_Customer.CityID , SET_City.CityName ,'' as Description, 0 as QuantityInvoiced, 0 as UnitPrice
from IMP_CustomClearing inner join Fabric_ImportCostingHeader on Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.CostingID = IMP_CustomClearing.CostingID and Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.CompanyID = IMP_CustomClearing.CompanyID and Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.PeriodID = IMP_CustomClearing.PeriodID and Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.Status = 1 inner join Fabric_ImportCostingDetail on Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.CostingID = Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.CostingID and Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.CompanyID = Fabric_ImportCostingHeader.CompanyID and Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.Status = 1 and Fabric_ImportCostingDetail.RD is null
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = IMP_CustomClearing.ClearingAgentID and ar_set_customer.PeriodID = IMP_CustomClearing.PeriodID
left Join SET_City on SET_City.CityID = ar_set_customer.CityID And SET_City.Status=1 and ar_set_customer.CityID <> -1
inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = IMP_CustomClearing.ClearingAgentID inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode
where IMP_CustomClearing.CompanyID = @CompanyID and IMP_CustomClearing.PeriodID = @PeriodID and IMP_CustomClearing.CreateDate between @FromDate and @ToDate AND IMP_CustomClearing.Status=1 and isnull(IMP_CustomClearing.GSTAmount,0) > 0 {1} {2}
union all
Select distinct AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName ,(Case when AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber='' then null else substring(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber ,0,8)+'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber ,8,len( AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber )-1) end )as NTNNumber ,(Case when AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber='' then null else substring(AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,0,3)+'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,3,2) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,5,4) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,9,3) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,12,len( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber )-1) end )as STRNNumber ,(Case when AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber='' then null else substring(AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber,0,6) +'-'+ substring(AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber,6,7) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber ,13,len( AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber )-1) end )as CNICNumber ,Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.CreateDate as InvoiceReceivedDate,'' as VendorReferenceNumber,Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.ImportDocumentID as VoucherNo,'Custom Clearing' as DocumentType , InclusiveServiceCharges as AmountPaid,
0 as TaxRate,
Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.GSTAmount As TaxAmount
,0 as WithTaxAmount
,AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1, AR_SET_Customer.CityID , SET_City.CityName ,'' as Description, 0 as QuantityInvoiced, 0 as UnitPrice
from Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.TransporterID and ar_set_customer.PeriodID = Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.PeriodID
left Join SET_City on SET_City.CityID = AR_SET_Customer.CityID And SET_City.Status=1 and ar_set_customer.CityID <> -1
inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.TransporterID inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode
where Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.CompanyID = @CompanyID and Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.PeriodID = @PeriodID and Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.CreateDate between @FromDate and @ToDate AND Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.Status=1 and isnull(Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.GSTAmount,0) > 0 {2} {1}
) as TAB

Select FinalTables.CompanyID,FinalTables.SupplierID,FinalTables.SupplierName,FinalTables.NTNNumber,FinalTables.DocumentType,FinalTables.InvoiceAmount,FinalTables.PaymentAmount,FinalTables.TaxPercentage ,FinalTables.TaxDeductionAmount,FinalTables.MonthYear,FinalTables.Comments,FinalTables.OpeningAmount, (Case When FinalTables.DocumentType <> 'Opening' Then FinalTables.OpeningAmount + FinalTables.InvoiceAmount - FinalTables.PaymentAmount Else 0 End) as ClosingAmount From ( Select * From ( Select FinalTab.CompanyID,FinalTab.SupplierID,FinalTab.SupplierName,FinalTab.NTNNumber,FinalTab.DocumentType,Sum(FinalTab.InvoiceAmount)InvoiceAmount ,Sum(FinalTab.PaymentAmount)PaymentAmount,Sum(FinalTab.TaxPercentage) as TaxPercentage, FinalTab.TaxDeductionAmount,FinalTab.MonthYear,FinalTab.Comments ,(Case When FinalTab.DocumentType <> 'Opening' Then 0 Else Sum(FinalTab.InvoiceAmount)-Sum(FinalTab.PaymentAmount) End) as OpeningAmount From (
Select FinTab.CompanyID, FinTab.SupplierID, FinTab.SupplierName, FinTab.NTNNumber,'Opening' as DocumentType, SUm(FinTab.InvoiceAmount)InvoiceAmount,SUm(FinTab.PaymentAmount)PaymentAmount,SUM(FinTab.TaxPercentage)TaxPercentage, FinTab.TaxDeductionAmount,FinTab.MonthYear,FinTab.Comments From ( Select Tab.CompanyID,Tab.InvoiceType as DocumentTypeID, Tab.DocumentType,Tab.InvoiceDate as DocumentDate,Tab.InvoiceNumber as DocumentNo,Tab.SupplierID, Tab.SupplierName,Tab.NTNNumber, Sum(Tab.InvoiceAmount) as InvoiceAmount, Sum(Tab.PaymentAmount)PaymentAmount,0 as TaxPercentage, Tab.TaxDeductionAmount,Tab.MonthYear, Tab.CodeCombinationID,Tab.CodeDescription, '' as Comments From ( SELECT DISTINCT AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, Format(AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate,'MM-yyyy') as MonthYear, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount AS InvoiceAmount, 0 AS PaymentAmount, 0 AS TaxPercentage, 0 AS TaxDeductionAmount, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode AS CodeCombinationID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description AS CodeDescription FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1
Inner JOIN AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail ON AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status = 1 INNER JOIN GL_CodeCombinationDetail ON GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 WHERE AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate < @FromDate {0} )Tab Group By Tab.CompanyID,Tab.InvoiceType,Tab.DocumentType ,Tab.InvoiceDate ,Tab.InvoiceNumber ,Tab.SupplierID, Tab.SupplierName,Tab.NTNNumber, Tab.CodeCombinationID,Tab.CodeDescription,Tab.TaxDeductionAmount,Tab.MonthYear
Union All
Select Tab.CompanyID,Tab.DocumentTypeID, Tab.DocumentType,Tab.DocumentDate,Tab.DocumentNo,Tab.SupplierID, Tab.SupplierName,Tab.NTNNumber, Sum(Tab.InvoiceAmount) as InvoiceAmount, Sum(Tab.PaymentAmount)PaymentAmount,Sum(Tab.TaxPercentage)TaxPercentage, Tab.TaxDeductionAmount,Tab.MonthYear, Tab.CodeCombinationID,Tab.CodeDescription, Tab.Comments From ( SELECT Distinct AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate, Format(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate,'MM-yyyy') as MonthYear, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber AS NTNNumber, 0 as InvoiceAmount, --(Case AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType when 'Debit' then AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount else AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount * -1 end) as Amount, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount as PaymentAmount, ISNULL(AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TaxPercentage,0) AS TaxPercentage, (Select ISNULL(SUM(Amount),0) as Amount from AP_Payment_AccountsDetail Where PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID And CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID And PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And Status = 1 ) as TaxDeductionAmount, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode as CodeCombinationID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription, AP_PaymentHeader.Comments FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AP_PaymentHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER Join AP_PaymentSupplierDetail on AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Status=1
Inner Join AP_PaymentBanksDetail on AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
INNER JOIN GL_CodeCombinationDetail ON GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode
WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate --And SET_DocumentType.DocumentType NOT Like '%Opening%' {0}
)Tab Group By Tab.CompanyID,Tab.DocumentTypeID,Tab.DocumentType ,Tab.DocumentDate ,Tab.DocumentNo ,Tab.SupplierID, Tab.SupplierName,Tab.NTNNumber, Tab.CodeCombinationID,Tab.CodeDescription,Tab.TaxDeductionAmount,Tab.MonthYear,Tab.Comments )FinTab Group By FinTab.CompanyID, FinTab.SupplierID, FinTab.SupplierName, FinTab.NTNNumber,FinTab.DocumentType,FinTab.TaxDeductionAmount,FinTab.MonthYear,FinTab.Comments
Union All
Select FinTab.CompanyID, FinTab.SupplierID, FinTab.SupplierName, FinTab.NTNNumber,FinTab.DocumentType, SUm(FinTab.InvoiceAmount)InvoiceAmount,SUm(FinTab.PaymentAmount)PaymentAmount,SUm(FinTab.TaxPercentage)TaxPercentage, FinTab.TaxDeductionAmount,FinTab.MonthYear,FinTab.Comments From ( Select Tab.CompanyID,Tab.InvoiceType as DocumentTypeID, Tab.DocumentType,Tab.InvoiceDate as DocumentDate, Tab.InvoiceNumber as DocumentNo,Tab.SupplierID, Tab.SupplierName,Tab.NTNNumber, Sum(Tab.InvoiceAmount) as InvoiceAmount, Sum(Tab.PaymentAmount)PaymentAmount,0 as TaxPercentage, Tab.TaxDeductionAmount,Tab.MonthYear, Tab.CodeCombinationID,Tab.CodeDescription,'' as Comments From ( SELECT DISTINCT AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, Format(AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate,'MM-yyyy') as MonthYear, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount AS InvoiceAmount, 0 AS PaymentAmount, 0 as TaxDeductionAmount, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode AS CodeCombinationID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description AS CodeDescription FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1
Inner JOIN AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail ON AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status = 1 INNER JOIN GL_CodeCombinationDetail ON GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 WHERE AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate {0} )Tab Group By Tab.CompanyID,Tab.InvoiceType,Tab.DocumentType ,Tab.InvoiceDate ,Tab.InvoiceNumber ,Tab.SupplierID, Tab.SupplierName,Tab.NTNNumber, Tab.CodeCombinationID,Tab.CodeDescription,Tab.TaxDeductionAmount,Tab.MonthYear
Union All
Select Tab.CompanyID,Tab.DocumentTypeID, Tab.DocumentType,Tab.DocumentDate,Tab.DocumentNo,Tab.SupplierID, Tab.SupplierName,Tab.NTNNumber, Sum(Tab.InvoiceAmount) as InvoiceAmount, Sum(Tab.PaymentAmount)PaymentAmount,SUM(Tab.TaxPercentage) as TaxPercentage, Tab.TaxDeductionAmount,Tab.MonthYear, Tab.CodeCombinationID,Tab.CodeDescription,Tab.Comments From ( SELECT Distinct AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate, Format(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate,'MM-yyyy') as MonthYear, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber AS NTNNumber, 0 as InvoiceAmount, --(Case AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType when 'Debit' then AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount else AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount * -1 end) as Amount, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount as PaymentAmount, ISNULL(AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TaxPercentage,0) AS TaxPercentage, (Select ISNULL(SUM(Amount),0) as Amount from AP_Payment_AccountsDetail Where PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID And CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID And PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And Status = 1 ) as TaxDeductionAmount, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode as CodeCombinationID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription ,AP_PaymentHeader.Comments FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AP_PaymentHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER Join AP_PaymentSupplierDetail on AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Status=1
Inner Join AP_PaymentBanksDetail on AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Status = 1
INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
INNER JOIN GL_CodeCombinationDetail ON GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode
WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID= @CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate Between @FromDate And @ToDate --And SET_DocumentType.DocumentType NOT Like '%Opening%' {0}
)Tab Group By Tab.CompanyID,Tab.DocumentTypeID,Tab.DocumentType ,Tab.DocumentDate ,Tab.DocumentNo ,Tab.SupplierID, Tab.SupplierName,Tab.NTNNumber, Tab.CodeCombinationID,Tab.CodeDescription,Tab.TaxDeductionAmount,Tab.MonthYear,Tab.Comments )FinTab Group By FinTab.CompanyID, FinTab.SupplierID, FinTab.SupplierName, FinTab.NTNNumber,FinTab.DocumentType,FinTab.TaxDeductionAmount,FinTab.MonthYear,FinTab.Comments
) as FinalTab Group By FinalTab.CompanyID,FinalTab.SupplierID,FinalTab.SupplierName,FinalTab.NTNNumber,FinalTab.DocumentType,FinalTab.TaxDeductionAmount,FinalTab.MonthYear,FinalTab.Comments )FinalTables )FinalTables Order by FinalTables.MonthYear asc

data.name: Query_SelectAll_ForApproveDetail
data.value: SELECT DISTINCT AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.PaymentID, AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CompanyID, AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.PeriodID, AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.Status, AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.DocumentNo, AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.RecievingDate, AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.StatusCode, SET_DocumentApprove.ApprovalStatus, SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalOperator, SET_ApprovalAuthority.UserID AS UserID, SET_Authority.AuthorityLevel FROM AP_AdvanceSugarPayment LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentApprove ON SET_DocumentApprove.CompanyID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentApprove.Status = 1 AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.DocumentNo INNER JOIN SET_UserApprovalAmount ON SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CompanyID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.PeriodID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.Status = 1 AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.DocumentTypeID OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID IS NULL) AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.UserID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CreatedBy OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.UserID IS NULL) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.RecievingDate, 110) AS DATETIME) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NOT NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.RecievingDate, 110) AS DATETIME) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NULL AND ( SELECT asp.AdvanceAmount FROM AP_AdvanceSugarPayment asp WHERE asp.CompanyID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CompanyID AND asp.PeriodID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.PeriodID AND asp.PaymentID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.PaymentID ) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NOT NULL AND ( SELECT asp.AdvanceAmount FROM AP_AdvanceSugarPayment asp WHERE asp.CompanyID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CompanyID AND asp.PeriodID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.PeriodID AND asp.PaymentID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.PaymentID ) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) INNER JOIN SET_ApprovalAuthority ON SET_ApprovalAuthority.ApprovalAuthorityID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalAuthorityID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Authority ON SET_Authority.AuthorityID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.AuthorityID AND SET_Authority.CompanyID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID AND SET_Authority.PeriodID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID AND SET_Authority.Status = 1 WHERE AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.Status = 1 AND AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.PaymentID = @PaymentID AND AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID AND AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.DocumentNo = @DocumentNo

SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalOperator, SET_ApprovalAuthority.UserID, SET_Authority.AuthorityLevel , Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName FROM AP_PaymentHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID --AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PayFromCustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentApprove ON SET_DocumentApprove.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentApprove.Status = 1 AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo AND SET_DocumentApprove.CreateDate = ( SELECT MAX(CreateDate) FROM SET_DocumentApprove WHERE CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID AND DocumentNo = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo ) INNER JOIN SET_UserApprovalAmount ON SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.Status = 1 AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID IS NULL) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NOT NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NULL AND (SELECT ph.Amount FROM AP_PaymentHeader ph WHERE ph.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND ph.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND ph.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT ph.Amount FROM AP_PaymentHeader ph WHERE ph.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND ph.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND ph.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) INNER JOIN SET_ApprovalAuthority ON SET_ApprovalAuthority.ApprovalAuthorityID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalAuthorityID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Authority ON SET_Authority.AuthorityID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.AuthorityID AND SET_Authority.CompanyID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID AND SET_Authority.PeriodID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID AND SET_Authority.Status = 1 inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID

SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID, AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID desc) AS 'Row' FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT PaymentHeader_Outer.PaymentID, PaymentHeader_Outer.CompanyID, PaymentHeader_Outer.PeriodID, PaymentHeader_Outer.Status, PaymentHeader_Outer.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, PaymentHeader_Outer.DocumentNo, PaymentHeader_Outer.DocumentDate, PaymentHeader_Outer.ReceiptDate, PaymentHeader_Outer.StatusCode, SET_DocumentApprove.ApprovalStatus, --SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalOperator, Set_documentPendingApprove.ApprovalOperator, SET_ApprovalAuthority.UserID AS UserID, --SET_Authority.AuthorityLevel, --Set_documentPendingApprove.ApprovalUserID AS UserID, PaymentHeader_Outer.Amount ,Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName, PaymentHeader_Outer.ControlCredit,PaymentHeader_Outer.CreatedByValue ,isnull(AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT distinct ', ' + AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName FROM AP_PaymentSupplierDetail inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID WHERE payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID and payment1.CompanyID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID and payment1.PeriodID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID and payment1.FiscalID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.FiscalID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Status = 1 --ORDER BY AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS CustomerName FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment1 where payment1.PaymentID = PaymentHeader_Outer.PaymentID and payment1.CompanyID = PaymentHeader_Outer.CompanyID and payment1.PeriodID = PaymentHeader_Outer.PeriodID and payment1.FiscalID = PaymentHeader_Outer.FiscalID ), '')) as CustomerName FROM AP_PaymentHeader PaymentHeader_Outer INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON PaymentHeader_Outer.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND PaymentHeader_Outer.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND PaymentHeader_Outer.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND PaymentHeader_Outer.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON PaymentHeader_Outer.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID --and PaymentHeader_Outer.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND PaymentHeader_Outer.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentApprove ON SET_DocumentApprove.CompanyID = PaymentHeader_Outer.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID = PaymentHeader_Outer.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentApprove.Status = 1 AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = PaymentHeader_Outer.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = PaymentHeader_Outer.DocumentNo AND SET_DocumentApprove.CreateDate = ( SELECT MAX(CreateDate) FROM SET_DocumentApprove WHERE CompanyID = PaymentHeader_Outer.CompanyID AND PeriodID = PaymentHeader_Outer.PeriodID AND DocumentTypeID = PaymentHeader_Outer.DocumentTypeID AND DocumentNo = PaymentHeader_Outer.DocumentNo AND FiscalID = PaymentHeader_Outer.FiscalID ) inner join Set_documentPendingApprove on Set_documentPendingApprove.DocumentApproveID = SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentApproveID and Set_documentPendingApprove.companyID = SET_DocumentApprove.companyID and Set_documentPendingApprove.PeriodID = SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID
INNER JOIN SET_UserApprovalAmount ON SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID = PaymentHeader_Outer.CompanyID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID = PaymentHeader_Outer.PeriodID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.Status = 1 AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID = PaymentHeader_Outer.DocumentTypeID OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID IS NULL) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NOT NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NULL AND (SELECT ph.Amount FROM AP_PaymentHeader ph WHERE ph.CompanyID = PaymentHeader_Outer.CompanyID AND ph.PeriodID = PaymentHeader_Outer.PeriodID AND ph.PaymentID = PaymentHeader_Outer.PaymentID) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT ph.Amount FROM AP_PaymentHeader ph WHERE ph.CompanyID = PaymentHeader_Outer.CompanyID AND ph.PeriodID = PaymentHeader_Outer.PeriodID AND ph.PaymentID = PaymentHeader_Outer.PaymentID) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))
left join UsersInRoles on UsersInRoles.RoleId = SET_UserApprovalAmount.RoleId and UsersInRoles.CompanyID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID
INNER JOIN SET_ApprovalAuthority ON SET_ApprovalAuthority.ApprovalAuthorityID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalAuthorityID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Authority ON SET_Authority.AuthorityID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.AuthorityID AND SET_Authority.CompanyID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID AND SET_Authority.PeriodID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID AND SET_Authority.Status = 1 Inner Join aspnet_Users AU ON AU.UserId = SET_ApprovalAuthority.UserID
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on PaymentHeader_Outer.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status=1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
) AP_PaymentHeader
