SET_Authority.PeriodID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID AND SET_Authority.Status = 1
INNER JOIN aspnet_UsersInRoles On aspnet_UsersInRoles.UserID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CreatedBy And (aspnet_UsersInRoles.RoleID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.RoleID or SET_UserApprovalAmount.RoleID is null)
--new Working (Roles aginst Approver) inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.DocumentTypeID inner join ApplicationMenu on ApplicationMenu.MenuID = SET_DocumentType.MenuID inner join MenusInRoles on MenusInRoles.MenuID = SET_DocumentType.MenuID inner join aspnet_Roles on aspnet_Roles.RoleId = MenusInRoles.RoleId
WHERE AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.Status = 1 AND AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.PaymentID = @PaymentID AND AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID AND AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.DocumentNo = @DocumentNo and aspnet_UsersInRoles.RoleId = aspnet_Roles.RoleId

data.name: Query_SupplierWiseSaleTax
data.value:
Select * from ( select distinct AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName ,(Case when AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber='' then null else substring(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber ,0,8)+'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber ,8,len( AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber )-1) end )as NTNNumber ,(Case when AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber='' then null else substring(AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,0,3)+'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,3,2) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,5,4) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,9,3) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,12,len( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber )-1) end )as STRNNumber ,(Case when AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber='' then null else substring(AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber,0,6) +'-'+ substring(AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber,6,7) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber ,13,len( AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber )-1) end )as CNICNumber ,Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as InvoiceReceivedDate,Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber as VendorReferenceNumber,Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber as VoucherNo,Set_DocumentType.DocumentType ,SUM(SAL_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount) as AmountPaid,max(Sal_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount) as TaxRate ,((SUM(SAL_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount) * isnull(max(Sal_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount),0)) / 100) As TaxAmount ,(SUM(SAL_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount) + ((SUM(SAL_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount) * isnull(max(Sal_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount),0))/ 100)) as WithTaxAmount ,AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1, tabl_city.CityName from Sal_InvoiceHeader inner join Sal_InvoiceDetail on Sal_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and Sal_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and Sal_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
inner join Set_DocumentType on Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType and Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID --and ar_set_customer.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and ar_set_customer.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
left join SET_City tabl_city on tabl_city.CityID = AR_SET_Customer.CityID and tabl_city.Status = 1
where Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and isnull(Sal_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0) > 0 {1} group by AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber,AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber,Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate,Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber ,Set_DocumentType.DocumentType,Sal_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid,AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber, AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1, tabl_city.CityName
union all
-- RECEIPT Multi supplier select distinct case when AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName is null then 'JOUNRAL VOUCHER' else AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName end as CustomerName ,(Case when AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber='' then null else substring(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber ,0,8)+'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber ,8,len( AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber )-1) end )as NTNNumber ,(Case when AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber='' then null else substring(AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,0,3)+'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,3,2) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,5,4) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,9,3) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,12,len( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber )-1) end )as STRNNumber ,(Case when AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber='' then null else substring(AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber,0,6) +'-'+ substring(AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber,6,7) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber ,13,len( AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber )-1) end )as CNICNumber
,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, '' as DocumentNo,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo as VoucherNo,Set_DocumentType.DocumentType ,case when AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName is null then AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.Amount else case when AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount > 0 then AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount else AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount end end as AmountPaid, case when AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName is null then 100 else (AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.Amount / (case when AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount > 0 then AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount else AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount end) * 100) end as TaxRate, (AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.Amount) as TaxAmount ,case when AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName is null then 0 else ((case when AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount > 0 then AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount else AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount end) - ((case when AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount > 0 then AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount else AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount end) * (AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.Amount / (case when AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount > 0 then AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount else AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount end) * 100) / 100))end as WithTaxAmount ,AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1, tabl_city.CityName from AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID left join AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail on AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.status = 1 and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptCustomerID = 1
inner join AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail on AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.status = 1
inner join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID --and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.CompanyID left join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerID --and ar_set_customer.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID and ar_set_customer.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID
left join SET_City tabl_city on tabl_city.CityID = AR_SET_Customer.CityID and tabl_city.Status = 1
where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and isnull(GL_CodeCombinationDetail.SaleTaxFlag,0) = 1 {1} ) as TAB {0}

data.name: Query_VendorWiseSaleTax
data.value:
Select * from ( Select distinct AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName ,(Case when AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber='' then null else substring(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber ,0,8)+'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber ,8,len( AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber )-1) end )as NTNNumber ,(Case when AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber='' then null else substring(AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,0,3)+'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,3,2) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,5,4) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,9,3) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,12,len( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber )-1) end )as STRNNumber ,(Case when AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber='' then null else substring(AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber,0,6) +'-'+ substring(AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber,6,7) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber ,13,len( AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber )-1) end )as CNICNumber ,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceReceivedDate,AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorReferenceNumber,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber as VoucherNo,Set_DocumentType.DocumentType , Case When AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' Then ABS((AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid)) - AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid * max(isnull(AR_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0)) / (100 + max(isnull(AR_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0))) else sum(AR_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount) end as AmountPaid,
max(isnull(AR_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0)) as TaxRate,
Case When AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' Then AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid * max(isnull(AR_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0)) / (100 + max(isnull(AR_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0))) else --(sum(AR_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount) * isnull(max(AR_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount),0) / 100) sum(convert(decimaL, isnull(TaxAmountOnNet,0))) end As TaxAmount
,(sum(AR_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount) + (sum(AR_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount) * isnull(max(AR_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount),0) / 100)) as WithTaxAmount
,AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1, AR_SET_Customer.CityID , SET_City.CityName,AR_ClaimInvoiceDetail.ClaimDate ,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate from AR_InvoiceHeader inner join AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.FiscalID = AR_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID and AR_InvoiceDetail.Status=1
Left Join AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail on AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.FiscalID = AR_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID AND AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Status = 1
inner join Set_DocumentType on Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType and Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID --and ar_set_customer.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and ar_set_customer.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
left Join SET_City on SET_City.CityID = ar_set_customer.CityID And SET_City.Status=1 and ar_set_customer.CityID <> -1
inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode
left join AR_ClaimInvoiceDetail on AR_ClaimInvoiceDetail.InvoiceID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_ClaimInvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_ClaimInvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_ClaimInvoiceDetail.status = 1
where AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID
AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status=1 AND AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode=1 --and isnull(AR_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0) > 0 and AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = 1 {0}
group by AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceReceivedDate,AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorReferenceNumber, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.TransactionType ,Set_DocumentType.DocumentType,AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber,AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber,AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber, AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1, AR_SET_Customer.CityID , SET_City.CityName,AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid ,AR_ClaimInvoiceDetail.ClaimDate,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate
) as TAB
Union All
Select * from ( Select distinct AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName
,(Case when AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber='' then null else substring(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber ,0,8)+'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber ,8,len( AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber )-1) end )as NTNNumber ,(Case when AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber='' then null else substring(AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,0,3)+'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,3,2) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,5,4) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,9,3) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,12,len( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber )-1) end )as STRNNumber ,(Case when AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber='' then null else substring(AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber,0,6) +'-'+ substring(AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber,6,7) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber ,13,len( AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber )-1) end )as CNICNumber ,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceReceivedDate,AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorReferenceNumber,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber as VoucherNo,Set_DocumentType.DocumentType , Case When AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' Then ABS((AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid)) - AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid * max(isnull(AR_SET_Tax.TaxRate,0)) / (100 + max(isnull(AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount,0))) else (SELECT sum(isnull(AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceAmount,0)) FROM AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail WHERE AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TaxID IS NOT NULL) end as AmountPaid,
max(isnull(AR_SET_Tax.TaxRate,0)) as TaxRate,
Case When AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' Then AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid * max(isnull(AR_SET_Tax.TaxRate,0)) / (100 + max(isnull(AR_SET_Tax.TaxRate,0))) else ((SELECT sum(AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceAmount) FROM AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail WHERE AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TaxID IS NOT NULL) * isnull(max(AR_SET_Tax.TaxRate),0) / 100) end As TaxAmount
,((SELECT sum(AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount) FROM AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail WHERE AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TaxID IS NULL) + ((SELECT sum(AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceAmount) FROM AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail WHERE AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TaxID IS NOT NULL) * isnull(max(AR_SET_Tax.TaxRate),0) / 100)) as WithTaxAmount
,AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1, AR_SET_Customer.CityID , SET_City.CityName,AR_ClaimInvoiceDetail.ClaimDate ,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate from AR_InvoiceHeader
inner join AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.FiscalID = AR_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status=1 and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TaxID is not null
Left Join AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail on AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.FiscalID = AR_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID AND AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Status = 1
inner join Set_DocumentType on Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType and Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
left join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID --and ar_set_customer.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID
left Join SET_City on SET_City.CityID = AR_SET_Customer.CityID And SET_City.Status=1 and AR_SET_Customer.CityID <> -1
left join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID left join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode
left join AR_ClaimInvoiceDetail on AR_ClaimInvoiceDetail.InvoiceID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_ClaimInvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_ClaimInvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_ClaimInvoiceDetail.status = 1
Left Join AR_SET_Tax on AR_SET_Tax.TaxID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TaxID And AR_SET_Tax.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID And AR_SET_Tax.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID And AR_SET_Tax.Status = 1
where AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID
AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status=1 AND AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode=1 And (DocumentType like 'DI-Invoice HO%' OR DocumentType like '%DI-Invoice Site') {0}
group by AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceReceivedDate,AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorReferenceNumber, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.TransactionType,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID ,Set_DocumentType.DocumentType,AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber,AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber,AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber, AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1, AR_SET_Customer.CityID , SET_City.CityName,AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid ,AR_ClaimInvoiceDetail.ClaimDate,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate
) as TAB
union all
Select * from ( Select distinct AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName ,(Case when AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber='' then null else substring(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber ,0,8)+'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber ,8,len( AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber )-1) end )as NTNNumber ,(Case when AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber='' then null else substring(AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,0,3)+'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,3,2) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,5,4) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,9,3) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber ,12,len( AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber )-1) end )as STRNNumber ,(Case when AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber='' then null else substring(AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber,0,6) +'-'+ substring(AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber,6,7) +'-'+ substring( AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber ,13,len( AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber )-1) end )as CNICNumber ,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceReceivedDate,AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorReferenceNumber,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber as VoucherNo,Set_DocumentType.DocumentType ,AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount as AmountPaid,
AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Amount / AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount * 100 as TaxRate,
AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Amount As TaxAmount
,AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount + AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Amount as WithTaxAmount
,AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1, AR_SET_Customer.CityID , SET_City.CityName ,AR_ClaimInvoiceDetail.ClaimDate ,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate from AR_InvoiceHeader left join AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.FiscalID = AR_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID and AR_InvoiceDetail.Status=1
inner Join AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail on AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.FiscalID = AR_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID AND AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Status = 1 and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID = '02-30-005-002'
inner Join AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.FiscalID = AR_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status = 1 AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID = 1
inner join Set_DocumentType on Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType and Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID and ar_set_customer.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID
left Join SET_City on SET_City.CityID = ar_set_customer.CityID And SET_City.Status=1 and ar_set_customer.CityID <> -1
inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode
left join AR_ClaimInvoiceDetail on AR_ClaimInvoiceDetail.InvoiceID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_ClaimInvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_ClaimInvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_ClaimInvoiceDetail.status = 1
where AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status=1 AND AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode=1 and AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = 1 {0} group by AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceReceivedDate,AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorReferenceNumber, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.TransactionType ,Set_DocumentType.DocumentType,AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber,AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber,AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber, AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1, AR_SET_Customer.CityID , SET_City.CityName,AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID ,AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount,AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Amount ,AR_ClaimInvoiceDetail.ClaimDate,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate ) as TAB
